subject: skip-justification-form
evidence: Shape chosen: a SECOND justified-skip form accepted alongside ^BLOCKER-\d+$ - a Pester tag SkipWhen:<kebab-reason>, matched by ^SkipWhen:[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$. Read from the test object's Tag collection (inherited through parent blocks), never from a comment. Rejected alternatives, with the reason each fails the from-the-test-object rule: BLOCKER-n, because blockers are being retired (this chain seq 9, blocker-1-retired) and "nothing in range to falsify" is an unmet precondition, not a defect; a Skip reason string, because -Skip: is evaluated at DISCOVERY and Pester records no reason there; Set-ItResult -Skipped -Because, because it needs the body to run, would force $NothingToFalsify to be recomputed in BeforeAll, and would make the gate parse ErrorRecord prose. The two tests, both -Skip:$NothingToFalsify since 47e2031, both get Tag SkipWhen:no-exempt-commit-in-range: tests/Trailers.Tests.ps1:126 "rejects a Co-Authored-By trailer" and tests/Trailers.Tests.ps1:141 "fails with an empty exemption list". Tagged per-It, not on the Describe, because the sibling "passes, using the exemption" does not skip and must not inherit a justification. TWO GATE SITES, NOT ONE: build/tasks/Test.build.ps1:105 Assert-SuiteClean (host) and build/InContainer.Test.ps1:118 (container). Same rule, independent implementations that ALREADY diverge - the container tolerates NotRun when ExcludeTag Docker explains it, the host treats every NotRun and Inconclusive as unjustified. Not extracted to a shared function in this pass: the divergence is deliberate and the two reporting media differ (Write-Build vs Write-Output plus JSON). Both gain the second form and a by-reason listing of justified skips; output/incontainer.json gains justified_skips[] of test+reason+tag. Baseline measured before any edit, branch feature/justified-skips off develop 3e47c9e: Invoke-Build Test.Unit exit 1, host pester passed=171 failed=0 skipped=2 NotRun=0 Inconclusive=0; Invoke-Build Test.InContainer exit 1, container passed=150 failed=0 skipped=2 total=173 duration_s=32.03 uid=1001 pwsh=7.6.6 Pester=6.1.0 ledger_head=49566694cf6d8f344a681d6f218cb49115e99f9269b769852cc632cbd1bfcd4b; unjustified_skips named exactly those two tests and nothing else, at both sites. FALSIFICATION OBLIGATION this decision must discharge: a scratch It carrying -Skip and neither tag form must drive BOTH gates to exit 1 naming it, after which it is removed and git status is clean. A gate that cannot go red on an untagged skip has replaced one honour system with another.
